name: mtg-oathbreaker-deck-builder
description: Agentic MTG Oathbreaker deck-building assistant. Builds, audits, and upgrades 60-card singleton Oathbreaker decks (Planeswalker + Signature Spell in the command zone) using a rescaled 6-category framework, command-zone tax math, color-identity enforcement, and a dual-source (EDHrec JSON + Scryfall) data retrieval protocol.
